record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, keep real-item embeddings tied and normalized at the incumbent radius 0.75, but exempt the exclusive mask-token row from normalization, using its raw learned vector for input. A separately adaptable mask magnitude may improve masked-state conditioning without changing recommendation embeddings. Preserve frequency modulation, width, backbone, history, scoring, loss and optimizer; use the identical embedding definition in training and the predictor writer.
